description: Create a free cryptographic proof of existence (PDR) for a digital artifact without payment. Dual mode: pass work_hash (Mode A, client-computed SHA-256 hex) OR content (Mode B, raw text/code ≤60KB — server hashes it, zero retention). Subject to rate limits (5/IP/day, 1000/day global). Returns shield_id, pdr_b64, and verify_url. For on-chain settlement proof, use notary_notarize_paid ($0.01 USDC on Base).
name: notary_free
